anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: Already let us come also upon the next wording: Speak toward all congregation of sons of Israel saying: On the tenth of this month let each take a sheep according to houses of fathers, each a sheep according to a house.
pass_b_english: And now let us come also to the next wording: Speak to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, saying: On the tenth of this month let each take a sheep according to the houses of the fathers, each a sheep according to a house (Exodus 12:3).
source_text: Ἤδη δὲ καὶ ἐπ[ὶ τὴν] ἑξῆς λέξ[ιν] ἔλθωμεν· [Λαλ]ῆσον πρὸς πᾶσαν συν[αγωγ]ὴν υἱῶν Ἰ(σρα)ὴλ λέγων· Τῇ δ[ε]κάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου λ[αβέ]τωσαν ἕκαστος [πρόβατον κα]τ’ <οἴκους πατριῶν, ἕκαστος πρόβατον κατ’> οἰκ[ίαν].
